Name: CHR_ACTIVATE_CONDITION_PARAM_ST
Description: Weather and in-game time conditions under which a character is active (appears). The row is picked by the map placement's Character Appearance Condition (MSB Enemy), or by NpcParam's when the placement's is 0. The time window from the placement's Activate Time fields replaces this row's when any of them is non-zero. Characters with neither use row 0, so row 0 should allow every weather and have no time window. A character outside its conditions is hidden and fades in or out (see EnemyCommonParam's Time-of-Day Spawn - Fade Phantom ID).

Fields.Name: Appear during Weather: Sunny
Fields.Description: Active while the current weather is Sunny (weather type 0). The weather check passes when no weather is set.

Fields.Name: Appear during Weather: Clear Sky
Fields.Description: Active while the current weather is Clear Sky (weather type 1).

Fields.Name: Appear during Weather: Light Cloud
Fields.Description: Active while the current weather is Light Cloud (weather type 10).

Fields.Name: Appear during Weather: Cloud
Fields.Description: Active while the current weather is Cloud (weather type 11).

Fields.Name: Appear during Weather: Rain
Fields.Description: Active while the current weather is Rain (weather type 20).

Fields.Name: Appear during Weather: Heavy Rain
Fields.Description: Active while the current weather is Heavy Rain (weather type 21).

Fields.Name: Appear during Weather: Storm
Fields.Description: Active while the current weather is Storm (weather type 30).

Fields.Name: Appear during Weather: Storm for Battle
Fields.Description: Active while the current weather is Storm for Battle (weather type 31).

Fields.Name: Time: Start Hour
Fields.Description: Hour of the in-game clock the active window starts at (start time = hour × 60 + minute, inclusive). All four times 0: no time condition. A start later than the end wraps past midnight (e.g. 20:00 to 05:59 for night-only characters).

Fields.Name: Time: Start Minute
Fields.Description: Minute of the active window's start time (see Time: Start Hour).

Fields.Name: Time: End Hour
Fields.Description: Hour of the in-game clock the active window ends at (end time = hour × 60 + minute, exclusive: 19:59 ends at 19:59:00). All four times 0: no time condition.

Fields.Name: Time: End Minute
Fields.Description: Minute of the active window's end time (see Time: End Hour).
